# Magnite / Rubicon Project
> Supply-side advertising technology and programmatic monetization platform documentation, resources, and company information.

Rubicon Project is now part of Magnite. The site and related documentation cover publisher monetization, programmatic advertising products, developer resources, support materials, and corporate information relevant to the former Rubicon Project brand and Magnite platform.

## Company
- [Home](https://rubiconproject.com/): Main corporate homepage for Rubicon Project, now part of Magnite.
- [About Magnite](https://www.magnite.com/about-us/): Overview of the company, mission, and advertising technology business.
- [Leadership](https://www.magnite.com/about-us/leadership/): Executive leadership team and company management information.
- [Careers](https://www.magnite.com/careers/): Open roles, culture, and hiring information across the company.
- [Contact](https://www.magnite.com/contact-us/): General contact options for sales, support, and business inquiries.

## Products
- [Publisher Solutions](https://www.magnite.com/publishers/): Overview of monetization products for media owners and publishers.
- [CTV Solutions](https://www.magnite.com/ctv/): Connected TV advertising and monetization platform information.
- [Streaming SSP](https://www.magnite.com/streaming/): Programmatic streaming and CTV supply-side platform overview.
- [Online Video](https://www.magnite.com/online-video/): Video monetization capabilities for digital publishers.
- [Display](https://www.magnite.com/display/): Display advertising monetization and supply-side tools.
- [Audience Solutions](https://www.magnite.com/audience-solutions/): Audience and data capabilities for advertising activation.

## Buyers
- [For Buyers](https://www.magnite.com/buyers/): Overview of buying solutions for agencies and advertisers.
- [Omnichannel Buying](https://www.magnite.com/omnichannel/): Cross-channel programmatic buying across CTV, video, and display.
- [Curated Deals](https://www.magnite.com/curator/): Deal curation and supply packaging capabilities for buyers.
- [Retail Media](https://www.magnite.com/retail-media/): Retail media advertising solutions and inventory access.
- [Identity Solutions](https://www.magnite.com/identity/): Identity and addressability capabilities for programmatic advertising.

## Resources
- [Resources Hub](https://www.magnite.com/resources/): Central library of reports, guides, webinars, and product resources.
- [Blog](https://www.magnite.com/blog/): Articles and updates on programmatic advertising and company news.
- [Case Studies](https://www.magnite.com/resources/case-study/): Customer stories and examples of platform outcomes.
- [Webinars](https://www.magnite.com/resources/webinar/): On-demand webinars covering products, trends, and best practices.
- [Reports](https://www.magnite.com/resources/report/): Research reports and market insights for digital advertising.
- [Guides](https://www.magnite.com/resources/guide/): Downloadable guides and educational materials for practitioners.

## Developer Documentation
- [Developer Portal](https://help.magnite.com/help): Entry point for Magnite product help and technical documentation.
- [Help Center](https://help.magnite.com/help): Support articles, setup instructions, and operational guidance.
- [Seller API Documentation](https://help.magnite.com/help/seller-api): Technical documentation for seller-facing API integrations.
- [Demand Manager Documentation](https://help.magnite.com/help/demand-manager): Product documentation for Demand Manager setup and usage.
- [Streaming Documentation](https://help.magnite.com/help/streaming): Technical help for streaming and CTV platform workflows.
- [Identity Hub Documentation](https://help.magnite.com/help/identity-hub): Documentation for identity-related configuration and platform features.

## Platform Support
- [Support Home](https://help.magnite.com/help): Main support portal for product and account assistance.
- [Getting Started](https://help.magnite.com/help/getting-started): Introductory setup and onboarding guidance for platform users.
- [Release Notes](https://help.magnite.com/help/release-notes): Product changes, updates, and release announcements.
- [Troubleshooting](https://help.magnite.com/help/troubleshooting): Articles for diagnosing common platform and integration issues.
- [Account Management](https://help.magnite.com/help/account-management): Guidance for account settings, permissions, and administration.
